about: Postings read through a real browser for Workday sources that answer HTTP 429 to GitHub's servers (scraper/tools/relay.js). scraper/index.mjs uses a firm's entry only when its own read of that firm fails. Each firm: readAt; complete = the whole Toronto / Hong Kong listing was read; postings = that listing, shaped like the adapter's rows; details = what the scanner would have parsed from the descriptions it wanted. A reading older than three weeks is ignored.
